jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon Customer Service handles hundreds of millions of customer contacts each year across every Amazon business. Our Associate Experience organization owns the products, platforms, and AI systems that determine how Customer Service Associates (CSAs) onboard, learn, receive coaching, improve performance, and collaborate with AI to deliver exceptional customer outcomes.  

  

As Customer Service evolves, associates will increasingly solve sophisticated customer problems while AI automates routine interactions. This requires fundamentally reimagining how Amazon develops, supports, and continuously improves one of the world’s largest workforces.  

  

We are seeking a Principal Product Manager to define the long\-term vision for Associate Experience.
  

  

This leader will establish the product strategy for the next generation of workforce experiences, spanning workforce intelligence, learning, coaching, performance management, associate communications, and future AI\-enabled experiences. You will define how Customer Service continuously learns from its workforce and transforms operational insights into better products, better associate experiences, and better customer outcomes.  

  

This is a highly strategic role requiring close partnership with Engineering, Science, Business Intelligence, UX, Operations, Routing, Workforce Planning, and senior leaders across Customer Service. The current platform does not exist in the form it needs to, providing a rare opportunity to define an entirely new product space.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

\> Define the long\-term vision and strategy for Associate Experience across Customer Service.  

\> Establish the multi\-year product roadmap spanning workforce development, workforce intelligence, and associate workspace experiences.  

\> Define how Customer Service measures, understands, and continuously improves workforce effectiveness.  

\> Drive product strategy across multiple engineering teams and partner organizations.  

\> Influence senior leadership on long\-term investments that improve associate capability, customer outcomes, and operational efficiency.  

\> Partner closely with Engineering, Applied Science, and Business Intelligence to transform operational insights into differentiated product capabilities.  

\> Author product strategy documents, investment narratives, and long\-term product visions presented to senior leadership.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* 8\+ years of technical product or program management experience
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience working with and influencing senior level stakeholders

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with AI/ML technologies
* Experience leading greenfield product initiatives with broad organizational impact.
* Experience in enterprise software, workforce technology, customer service, or productivity platforms.

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. jobs.title: Custom Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Project Role :** Custom Software Engineer  

**Project Role Description :** Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high\-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs.
  

**Must have skills :** Salesforce Marketing Cloud  

**Good to have skills :** Marketing Operations  

Minimum **5** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Role Overview  

The Campaign \& Webinar Operations Specialist will support the Global Demand Center by executing email campaigns, customer communications, and webinar programs that engage prospects and customers across the full marketing funnel. This role is primarily responsible for the hands\-on execution of marketing programs, including campaign build, QA, deployment, broadcast management, and performance tracking across Pardot and ON24\.  

This role focuses on the execution layer of demand generation and customer communications, ensuring that campaigns and webinars are delivered accurately, consistently, and at scale. The role is not intended to define campaign strategy or messaging instead, it is responsible for translating defined requirements into operational execution, maintaining quality control, and ensuring that programs run reliably from build through reporting.  

This role will operate within a broader U.S. led Global Demand Center, partnering closely with campaign managers, product marketing, field marketing, Marketing Operations, RevOps, and Digital teams to support campaign delivery, webinar execution, and program reporting. The role requires strong attention to detail, platform fluency, and the ability to manage recurring programs and live execution environments with a high degree of reliability.  

Key Responsibilities  

Email Campaign Execution \& Customer Communications  

Build, QA, and deploy email campaigns in Pardot to support customer communications (product updates, lifecycle messaging) and demand generation programs (cross\-sell, upsell, new acquisition).  

Translate defined campaign requirements into Pardot assets, including email templates, dynamic content, segmentation inputs, and campaign structures.  

Execute campaign scheduling, send operations, and deployment timing aligned to global marketing calendars.  

Validate campaign setup, ensuring correct audience selection, suppression logic, personalization tokens, tracking parameters, and campaign attribution alignment.  

Conduct QA and regression testing across campaign assets, links, forms, trigger logic, and downstream tracking to ensure error\-free execution.  

Support A/B testing (subject lines, content variations, timing) and ensure test design is properly configured and measured.  

Monitor email deliverability, list hygiene, opt\-outs, and suppression compliance to maintain appropriate communication practices.  

Maintain campaign execution documentation, templates, QA checklists, and process standards to support repeatable workflows.  

  

Webinar Program Execution (ON24\)  

Own execution of webinar programs across customer and prospect audiences (20–24 webinars per year), including setup, testing, broadcast, and post\-event processing.  

Configure ON24 webinar environments, including registration pages, event consoles, integration with Pardot/Salesforce, and email triggers.  

Conduct speaker preparation, dry runs, and technical checks to ensure readiness prior to live broadcast.  

Manage live webinar delivery, including broadcast monitoring, attendee experience, troubleshooting, and moderation support.  

Execute post\-webinar processes, including recording management, publishing, transcription coordination, and asset distribution.  

Ensure attendee and engagement data is captured, validated, and integrated into CRM and marketing automation systems for follow\-up and reporting.  

  

Reporting, Integration \& Operational Support  

Track and report performance across email and webinar programs, including open rates, click\-through rates, registration, attendance, engagement, and campaign contribution.  

Ensure campaign and webinar data is properly structured to support downstream reporting, attribution, and pipeline measurement.  

Monitor integration points between Pardot, ON24, and Salesforce to ensure accurate data flow, campaign reporting, and lead tracking.  

Troubleshoot campaign and webinar execution issues, escalating to Marketing Operations, RevOps, or platform owners when required.  

Partner with segmentation, data, and marketing operations teams to ensure audience readiness and campaign execution alignment.  

Identify recurring execution inefficiencies and recommend process improvements, automation opportunities, or standardization approaches.  

Required Skills and Experience  

Hands\-on experience executing marketing campaigns in marketing automation platforms, with Pardot (Marketing Cloud Account Engagement) required.  

Hands\-on experience executing webinars using ON24 (or comparable enterprise webinar platform), including broadcast management.  

Strong understanding of campaign operations, including email setup, QA processes, segmentation inputs, personalization, and campaign tracking.  

Experience supporting customer communications, lifecycle marketing, and demand generation programs.  

Familiarity with Salesforce CRM, campaign objects, and lead/contact data structures.

Today that experience is fragmented across too many systems, partners, and manual processes. We're hiring a Senior Product Manager \- Technical to own the product strategy that consolidates these into a unified platform, dramatically reducing cost\-to\-serve while delivering a self\-service experience employees prefer over the alternatives.
   

  

 You'll partner with engineering, science, and design teams alongside third\-party partners to deliver intelligent automation, personalized experiences, and modern customer service capabilities. AI\-powered intelligent personalization and automation are tools in your toolkit, not the job description itself. You should be energized by applying them to genuinely eliminate friction, not just modernize the wrapper around legacy processes. This requires someone who takes ownership of ambiguous problems, makes hard build\-vs\-buy calls, and delivers measurable results at pace.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Define product requirements for self\-service capabilities that reduce support contacts, eliminate manual work, and cut expense processing time.
* Evaluate and apply emerging AI capabilities for knowledge orchestration, intelligent routing, and agentic automation, to deliver measurable product improvements.
* Collaborate with technical programme managers and engineering teams to translate product vision into high\-quality technical solutions
* Drive the product strategy for shifting from fragmented third\-party dependencies to first\-party platform ownership, informing build\-vs\-buy decisions that permanently restructure the cost base
* Lead and develop a team of product managers and analysts; hire bar\-raising talent
* Influence cross\-functional global teams across finance, HR, and workplace technology to resolve dependencies and deliver shared outcomes

* Write compelling narratives, strategy documents, and business cases to contribute to executive alignment, investment, and cross\-organizational resourcing for transformation initiatives


 A day in the life
   

  

 Start with a backlog review with your team, sharpening acceptance criteria for a self\-service workflow that eliminates a manual handoff. Move to a design sprint with engineers where you're debating trade\-offs between two integration approaches and deciding which to prototype first. Progress with synthesizing customer feedback into a revised requirements doc, then pressure\-testing priorities with an existing third\-party partner.  Amazon Travel \& Events exists to make every business trip and event seamless, safe, and cost\-effective for over 500,000 employees across 64 countries. Our Technology \& Data Solutions team is the builder behind that mission, designing the platforms and data capabilities that let employees plan, book, and manage travel and events and expense re\-imbursements with as little effort as possible. You'll lead large\-scale, complex programs through the entire development lifecycle, partnering with engineering teams, product managers, and stakeholders across multiple organizations. If you thrive on solving ambiguous problems, coordinating across diverse teams, and delivering impact that directly shapes customer experience, this role is for you.

You'll start your day meeting with product managers to understand their vision and translate it into technical requirements, then collaborate with engineering teams and Software Development Managers to create work\-backwards plans. Throughout the day, you engage stakeholders with progress updates, escalate when engineering teams encounter blockers, and manage multiple large programs simultaneously. jobs.description:

---------------


Amazon's mission is to be 'Earth’s most customer\-centric company,' and our award\-winning Customer Service (CS) team is a key part of that mission. Amazon CS is among the world's largest customer service organizations, with tens of thousands of Customer Service Associates providing world\-class support around the clock in over 20 languages. The Concessions team enhances CS by developing sophisticated products for both customers and Customer Service Associates. These solutions enable seamless self\-service and automation for customers, while allowing associates to effectively address issues through intuitive, human\-centered design.  

We are seeking a talented leader with strong technical and management background to join our Customer Experience Products organization on the CS Concessions Tech team. In this role, you will lead a team that is reimagining how we remediate Amazon customers in a Native AI\-world, leading the redesign and revamp of the 15 year old monolith. You will have the opportunity to influence a large group of product owners, software engineers, machine learning experts, and data scientists globally as we build the foundation that powers customer service experiences across Amazon. This role will give you the chance to tackle challenges that influence millions of customers, sellers, and products around the world.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Lead the design, implementation, and successful delivery of large\-scale software efforts involving significant work on the CS Concessions stack, working backwards from customer needs to define vision and architecture.
* Create, prioritize, communicate, manage, and execute roadmaps and project plans while reporting on status of development, quality, operations, and system performance to management.
* Foster a culture of continuous engineering improvement through mentoring, feedback, and metrics while building a strong cross\-functional organization through effective hiring, coaching, and talent development.
* Partner with diverse stakeholders to understand requirements, priorities, and processes, serving as the primary point of contact for project deliverables across teams.
* Propose and implement new projects and system improvements, setting clear, measurable quality goals for your organization in a data\-driven way that improves performance and cost efficiency.

  

A day in the life  

You'll tackle challenges that influence millions of customers, sellers, and products around the world. Your day involves collaborating with team members on design decisions, reviewing code, and troubleshooting production systems. You'll balance immediate deliverables with planning for longer\-term architectural improvements, all while leading your team through development cycles measured in weeks, not years. You'll spend time mentoring engineers, aligning stakeholders, and ensuring your team has what they need to deliver exceptional results.  

  

About the team  

WW Concessions, part of CS, develops and scale products and services that enable customers, CSAs, and Amazon employees to process concessions in an automated, secure and consistent way. Concessions are remediations issued to customers in response to a defect to rectify bad customer experiences and rebuild their trust. The product portfolio includes customer\-facing experiences, automation products, policy system and concession issuance workflows at a global scale. We focus on robust architecture, world\-class UX, and leverage our Big Data to drive insights and solutions through a myriad of applications.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

* 7\+ years of engineering experience

* Experience partnering with product or program management teams
* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems

* Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
*You co\-own the ontology with the CMO and personally write the canonical assets — deep, hands\-on, the keeper of the language. No team to build; the craft is yours.* 





 This is not a messaging role in the ordinary sense. Revenue Activation is a category we are building, and a category lives or dies on the precision of its language. You’ll co\-own that language with the CMO and personally produce the work: the positioning, the narrative, the canonical assets. You inherit a system locked in its core — with the mandate to evolve it deliberately rather than let it drift. This is a hands\-on\-keys role: you are the person who writes and guards the language, not someone who manages people who do.
 




*The hardest part of this job is holding a locked system in your head and knowing the difference between evolving it and eroding it. Most people soften vocabulary under pressure from a confused prospect. You’ll defend it — or change it on purpose, with a reason.* 



**What you’ll own** 
* **The ontology.** 

 the category, the metric (Revenue Capacity per Rep, never “productivity”), the persona, the product architecture and its cluster names, the retired vocabulary. Co\-owned with the CMO — a second mind on the framework.
* **Product narrative.** 

 you personally write positioning and messaging for Nucleus — launches, pitch narrative, one\-pagers, migration stories, battle cards — each checked against the ontology before it ships.
* **The claim line.** 

 GA versus roadmap honesty is a hard discipline. You keep claims tied to what’s deployed — credibility is the category’s currency.
* **Competitive positioning.** 

 how we position against merged incumbents and architecturally adjacent challengers, on terms we win.


**What you’ve done before** 
* 5\+ years in B2B SaaS product marketing, ideally inside a category\-creation or redefinition motion.
* You think in frameworks and systems, not slogans. You feel it when something violates a taxonomy.
* You write doctrine\-grade prose yourself — the kind a practitioner forwards. Sample work matters more than a campaign portfolio.
* You’ve partnered closely with product and a founder/CEO and can translate architecture into argument.
* You’re energized by being the craftsperson who owns the language — not by managing a team that does. You can disagree with a strong\-minded CMO productively and commit once the call is made.


**How we’ll know it’s working** 
* The category vocabulary holds across every asset and every rep — no drift, no softening.
* Sales reaches for the narrative because it wins deals.
* The ontology evolves deliberately, with reasons, as we grow.
* Prospects start using our words.

jobs.title: Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Financial Analyst is responsible for analyzing financial performance, monitoring manufacturing costs, preparing budgets and forecasts, conducting variance analysis, and supporting management with data\-driven financial insights. The role ensures effective cost control, profitability analysis, and financial compliance to improve operational efficiency within the manufacturing unit.

Key ResponsibilitiesFinancial Planning \& Analysis (FP\&A)

* Prepare annual budgets, monthly forecasts, and long\-term financial plans.
* Monitor actual performance against budgets and forecasts.
* Perform variance analysis and identify key business drivers.
* Prepare monthly Management Information System (MIS) reports.

Cost Analysis

* Analyze manufacturing costs including:
* Raw Material Cost
* Labour Cost
* Overhead Cost
* Production Cost per Unit
* Monitor standard costing and actual costing.
* Conduct product\-wise and department\-wise profitability analysis.
* Recommend cost reduction initiatives.

Manufacturing Performance Analysis

* Monitor Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) such as:
* Production Efficiency
* Machine Utilization
* Material Yield
* Inventory Turnover
* Capacity Utilization
* Analyze production losses and wastages.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives.

Financial Reporting

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly financial reports.
* Generate dashboards for senior management.
* Assist in month\-end and year\-end financial closing.
* Present financial insights to management.

Inventory \& Working Capital Analysis

* Analyze inventory valuation and stock movements.
* Monitor slow\-moving and obsolete inventory.
* Track working capital and cash flow.
* Support inventory audits.

Budgeting \& Forecasting

* Coordinate with production, procurement, sales, and operations for budgeting.
* Prepare rolling forecasts.
* Analyze budget deviations.

Business Analysis

* Conduct feasibility studies for new products and projects.
* Evaluate capital expenditure proposals.
* Perform break\-even analysis and ROI calculations.
* Support strategic business decisions through financial modeling.

Compliance \& Internal Controls

* Ensure compliance with company financial policies.
* Support statutory and internal audits.
* Maintain proper documentation for financial analysis.
* Identify financial risks and recommend mitigation measures.

Pay: ₹80,000\.00 \- ₹120,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

**About Amazon Finance Operations**
 Amazon Finance Operations (FinOps) supports every business line and geography across Amazon — paying Vendors and Suppliers (Procure to Pay), collecting cash (Order to Cash), and paying employees (Payroll) on time, accurately, and with the best experience. As Amazon grows, so does the demand for FinOps services — and we're fundamentally rethinking how we deliver them.
   

  

 The Opportunity
   

  

 We're recruiting a Senior Business Analyst for our FinOps Program Management Office (PMO) who will combine deep BA expertise with a forward\-looking mandate — designing, deploying, and scaling AI agents that automate repeatable analysis tasks and accelerate delivery for our customers across the organization. You'll define the strategy for how AI transforms business analysis delivery, build intelligent workflows that compress timelines from weeks to days, and drive adoption across teams — while applying your expertise where it matters most: solving ambiguous problems, influencing senior stakeholders, and making strategic trade\-offs that AI can't.
   

  

 This is a role for someone who can operate independently with limited guidance, manage the lifecycle of complex initiatives across multiple teams, and shape how an entire organization delivers.

 AI Strategy \& Scalable Delivery Transformation
   

  

* Define and own the AI\-enabled delivery strategy for BA workflows across the PMO — determining where automation creates the highest leverage and driving adoption across teams
* Architect intelligent workflows that automate repeatable BA tasks at scale — requirements drafting, validation, traceability, impact analysis — compressing delivery timelines organization\-wide
* Establish governance frameworks ensuring AI\-generated outputs meet controllership standards, and iterate on agent performance based on measurable outcomes
* Force\-multiply by enabling other BAs and PMs to leverage AI tools effectively — building the mechanisms, guidelines, and training that make the capability self\-sustaining


 Program Leadership \& Complex Problem Solving
   

  

* Own end\-to\-end delivery of complex, cross\-functional initiatives spanning multiple teams and business units — from strategy definition through execution and post\-launch measurement
* Navigate ambiguity: define program scope, success criteria, and execution plans where the business problem or solution may not be well\-defined

* Proactively identify risks, dependencies, and failure modes — mitigating before they become roadblocks


 Requirements Leadership \& Quality
   

  

* Set the standard for requirements analysis across the team — ensuring completeness, consistency, feasibility, and verifiability at scale
* Translate complex business and customer needs into actionable specifications grounded in data, and influence roadmap priorities based on business impact
* Create and refine standardized BA processes, artifacts, and mechanisms that raise team maturity and effectiveness across the organization


 Stakeholder Influence \& Communication
   

  

* Partner with and influence senior leaders on priorities, resource allocation, and strategic direction
* Drive alignment across multiple teams with competing priorities — building consensus and resolving contention constructively
* Communicate effectively in writing and verbally to Directors and VPs — narratives, business cases, program reviews, and escalations


 Business Process Analysis \& Optimization
   

  

* Evaluate end\-to\-end business processes across AP, AR, and Compliance verticals — identifying automation opportunities that significantly reduce cycle times and eliminate unnecessary process
* Streamline and simplify: judiciously add, refine, and remove procedures to increase team productivity and delivery speed
* Analyze data and metrics to identify trends, measure impact, and drive decisions

 A Day in the Life
   

  

 You operate at both the strategic and tactical level. You might start the day reviewing AI agent performance metrics and refining automation workflows, then shift to facilitating a cross\-functional alignment session where you're driving consensus across teams with competing priorities. You present a program narrative to a Director, then coach a BA on how to leverage AI tools for a complex requirements effort.

jobs.description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  

JLL Technologies
  
Product Manager, Smart Building Platform
  
  

Team
  
Workplace Management Product
  
  

The Opportunity
  
JLL manages real estate for some of the world’s largest organizations. Behind the scenes, a small product team is rebuilding how that work happens — replacing disconnected building systems, reactive maintenance cycles, and siloed sensor data with unified operational intelligence and AI\-powered workflows.
  
  

This role sits at the center of that shift. As PM for the Smart Building Platform, you will own a next\-generation product that unifies building systems, IoT data streams, and operational analytics to help clients achieve breakthrough gains in efficiency, sustainability, and occupant experience — across portfolios that span millions of square feet.
  
  

A defining part of this role is knowing how to operate at the edge of first\- and third\-party product boundaries: building systems, IoT protocols, and CMMS integrations are rarely clean. You will be the person who defines where JLL’s platform ends and where a vendor’s capability begins — and then builds the right thing in the right place.
  
  

**What makes this role unusual:**  

You are PM for the Smart Building Platform — which means real ownership, not a sub\-feature. You will set the roadmap, write the requirements, and be accountable for outcomes.
  
  

The AI work here is live, not aspirational. Agentic workflows on MCP architecture, NLQ interfaces into building data, and AI\-accelerated prototyping are active investment areas — not backlog items.
  
  

Third\-party building systems are not black boxes here. You will own the integration strategy for BMS, IoT, and CMMS platforms with the rigor of a first\-party product owner.
  
  

What You Will Work On
  
Smart Building Platform strategy and roadmap
  
You will own the product roadmap for the Smart Building Platform, balancing near\-term delivery against long\-term strategic vision. That means translating client needs, market signals, and business objectives into a prioritized backlog — and defending those priorities with data. You will ensure the platform stays tightly aligned with JLL’s WPM delivery infrastructure and revenue goals, and evolve the roadmap as the IoT and AI landscape shifts underneath it.
  
  

Building systems and IoT integration
  
Smart building products live or die on integration depth. You will define the integration strategy for building management systems (BMS/BAS), IoT sensor platforms, and CMMS systems — owning the specs that bridge protocols like BACnet and Modbus with JLL’s data layer. You will work closely with engineering to ensure the platform surfaces building system data in ways that are actionable, not just visible.
  
  

AI and agentic product development
  
Workplace OS is JLL’s agentic platform, built on MCP architecture and natural language query capabilities. Your job is to define what Smart Building agents should do, and then build and ship them. That includes agents that reach into building systems to retrieve operational data, surface anomalies before they become incidents, and route work automatically based on real\-time conditions.
  
  

This means building working AI prototypes — not just writing specs — to validate ideas quickly before engineering commitment. It means using AI tools (Claude, Copilot, and similar LLMs) as a daily productivity multiplier: synthesizing discovery findings, stress\-testing requirements. And it means knowing the difference between a demo and a workflow\-grade capability.
  
  

Requirements, specs, and delivery
  
You will define high\-quality product specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria — using AI tools with designers to accelerate drafting, iteration, and engineering handoff.
  
Your requirements are not long drawn\-out documents but real working prototypes that you would have built along side your users. You will then work with engineering to bring those to production.
  
You will partner with engineering and program managers through the full planning\-to\-release lifecycle, and define the success metrics that determine whether what shipped actually worked.
  
  

Cross\-functional leadership
  
You will build and maintain strong working relationships with engineering, program management, operations, sales, and client success. You will represent the platform in executive reviews, client conversations, and external forums. You will navigate ambiguity confidently, making well\-reasoned decisions with incomplete information when the moment requires it.
  
  

How You Will Spend Your Time
  
No two weeks look identical, but across a typical quarter you will be:
  
  

Owning and prioritizing the Smart Building Platform roadmap, translating stakeholder input and discovery findings into a clear product direction that engineering can execute against
  
Running discovery sessions with facilities teams, implementation leads, and enterprise clients to surface workflow pain and validate product direction
  
Writing integration specs for BMS, IoT, and CMMS connections, with enough technical depth to lead the engineering conversation
  
Building AI prototypes in collaboration with engineering — using LLM tooling and MCP integrations to validate use cases before committing to a full …

jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

  

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.


Based in San Francisco, CA, **Rippling has raised $1\.85B\+** from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.


We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

  

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead a high\-impact platform engineering team responsible for core infrastructure and product foundations used across Rippling. This role owns multiple horizontal charters, including Data Deletion, Webscripts, Internationalisation, and Rippling Config Service. These systems sit at the intersection of platform scalability, developer productivity, compliance, configuration management, and customer\-facing product quality. The ideal candidate is a strong engineering leader who can operate across ambiguous problem spaces, partner deeply with product and infrastructure teams, and build durable systems that scale with Rippling’s product surface.

### **What You’ll Do**

* Lead and grow a team of engineers working on critical platform charters.
* Own technical strategy and execution for Data Deletion, Webscripts, Internationalisation, and Rippling Config Service.
* Partner with product, design, compliance, security, and infrastructure teams to define roadmaps and delivery plans.
* Drive architecture reviews and ensure systems are reliable, scalable, maintainable, and secure.
* Establish clear ownership, operational excellence, and engineering quality across multiple platform surfaces.
* Balance short\-term product needs with long\-term platform investments.
* Mentor senior engineers and engineering leads, helping them grow their technical judgment and leadership.
* Improve execution rigor through planning, prioritization, metrics, incident reviews, and continuous process improvement.
* Represent the team in cross\-functional forums and communicate tradeoffs clearly to senior leadership.

### **What We’re Looking For**

* 12\+ years of software engineering experience, with 3\+ years managing engineering teams.
* Experience leading platform, infrastructure, developer productivity, or shared product\-surface teams.
* Strong technical judgment and ability to reason about distributed systems, data models, APIs, reliability, and scale.
* Proven ability to lead ambiguous, cross\-functional charters with multiple stakeholders.
* Experience managing senior engineers and driving alignment across teams.
* Strong execution discipline: roadmap planning, project delivery, operational metrics, and incident follow\-through.
* Ability to balance product velocity with long\-term platform quality.
* Clear written and verbal communication, especially around tradeoffs and technical strategy.

### **Nice To Have**

* Experience with privacy, compliance, data lifecycle, or data deletion systems(GDPR, CCPA).
* Experience building internal platforms or frameworks used by many product teams.
* Experience with internationalisation/localisation systems.
* Experience with configuration platforms, feature/config rollout systems, or policy/config management.
* Experience with low\-code, scripting, workflow, or extensibility platforms.

### **Why This Role Matters**

  

This team builds foundational systems that many Rippling products depend on. The role requires someone who can think like a platform owner: creating leverage for other teams, reducing duplication, improving reliability, and ensuring that core systems continue to scale as Rippling grows across products, countries, and customer segments.

### **About You**

  

You are a hands\-on engineering leader who enjoys operating at both technical and organizational levels. You can dive into architecture when needed, but your real strength is creating clarity, building strong teams, and helping engineers deliver high\-quality systems in complex environments.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------


Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling.com


Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Want to define how millions of customers experience third\-party services through Alexa\+? Alexa 3P Quality \& Experiences ensures every ride booking, restaurant reservation, and travel plan delivers a frictionless experience. If you're passionate about turning raw customer signals into actionable quality insights—while operating at the intersection of Generative AI and large\-scale data systems—this role is for you. Work with us to scale quality for 3P experiences across multiple integration patterns and international locales, all while pioneering AI\-powered quality improvements and fixes.  

  

The Alexa 3P Quality \& Experiences team is seeking an experienced Business Intelligence Engineer who transforms ambiguous, high\-volume customer experience data into metrics that drive decisions. Using a combination of deep technical skills and cross\-functional influence, this candidate will be the key BI partner between quality monitoring operations, ASK product teams, and 3P partner engagement. Primary areas of focus will be: 1\) defining and operationalizing quality metrics (CPDR, CPQR, friction rates, task completion funnels) across experiences and locales, 2\) building scalable data pipelines that power AI\-driven investigation tools, and 3\) deep\-diving large datasets to surface cross\-expert defect patterns invisible to manual analysis.  

  

A successful candidate will be an expert with SQL, ETL, and data modeling for customer experience signals at scale. They will build dashboards that translate high\-volume utterance data into clear quality narratives for VP\-level reviews. The candidate will need to be a self\-starter, comfortable with ambiguity in a fast\-paced environment with rapidly expanding scope, and able to think big about automation\-first measurement systems while paying careful attention to data accuracy and statistical rigor.

Your primary focus is turning messy, high\-volume customer experience data into the metrics and dashboards that tell leadership what's broken, why, and what to fix first—across both pre\-launch quality assurance and post\-launch monitoring for third\-party experiences on Alexa\+.  

  

On a typical day, you'll pull overnight quality signals, validate whether a metric spike is a real customer problem or a data artifact, and have an answer ready before standup. You'll build and maintain the data pipelines that feed AI\-powered investigation tools—and then audit those tools to prove they're actually accurate. You'll partner with product engineers to quantify defect impact, with operations teams who use your dashboards to prioritize investigations, and with partner\-facing teams who need data to drive conversations with third\-party developers. You'll also work closely with AI/ML tool owners—providing ground\-truth datasets and measuring whether automation is delivering on its promise.  

  

Beyond the day\-to\-day, you'll shape how quality is measured as new experiences and international markets launch. You'll define what "good" looks like before Day 1, build the scorecards that track it, and own the narrative in weekly executive reviews.

We help our partners create value, and deliver a business we love. Our business mission is focused towards the following areas:  

1\) Distribute Alexa across 3P endpoints such as smart TVs and speaker profitably drive incremental endpoints and new\-to\-Alexa customer acquisition  

2\) Bring value to customers in hotels, senior living communities, and healthcare properties  

3\) Offer branded conversational AI assistants to partners  

4\) Ensure product certification, quality checks, and developer support to partners  

We serve world\-class customers across the industry. Our products have been featured in publications such as CNET and Forbes, and Amazon has celebrated our progress in its quarterly earnings highlights. Built on an API\-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.
   

  

**PRODUCT OWNER**
**Position Summary**
 We are seeking experienced Product Owners to help deliver on our product objectives and roadmaps. Product Owners are responsible for delivering product outcomes and functionality that meet customer and user needs. They translate product vision and insights into prioritized features and user stories, developed by their agile team of 8–10 members.
   

  

 This role collaborates with Candescent clients and Product Managers to identify and prioritize requirements for enhancements to the Banking Platform. Product Owners also work with the Product Advisory Council, participating in user group discussions and presenting both strategic and tactical functionality. Additional responsibilities include release planning, product roadmap maintenance, and backlog grooming for assigned Candescent Banking Services initiatives.
   

  

**Key Areas of Responsibility**
* Lead efforts to define specific functions, integration requirements, user experiences, and deployment strategies for delivery to both the company and market
* Develop, shape, and refine user stories, problem statements, and acceptance criteria to ensure efficient and effective team consumption
* Collaborate with the broader product organization to ensure integration across all Candescent Digital Banking Technology products
* Work closely with the development team to ensure that delivered products meet specified requirements and are delivered on time and within budget
* Drive understanding of the work to be completed by the development team, supporting effective sprint sequencing and incremental delivery
* Participate actively in scrum ceremonies such as sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, daily stand\-ups, and demos
* Maintain functional quality by setting and evaluating expectations and acceptance criteria
* Present and train internal customers on new platform features and services released in each version

**Product Design and Development**
* Participate in PI (Program Increment) planning to prioritize the roadmap and inform team backlogs
* Write and prioritize user stories based on business needs, user requirements, and technical feasibility

jobs.description:
**Job Description Summary**
**Job Description**
 We are building a secure, compliant, and highly reliable healthcare data platform that transports and transforms clinical and operational data from hospital on‑premises environments to the cloud. As a Sr. Staff Technical Product Owner, you will own the product vision, roadmap, and outcomes for end‑to‑end data movement, interoperability, and governance—working across global product managers in multiple healthcare sub‑segments to deliver interoperable, scalable, and cost‑efficient data capabilities.
   

  

**What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities)**
* Own vision \& roadmap
+ Translate organizational strategy into a platform‑level multi‑release roadmap with clear value milestones and measurable outcomes.
+ Continuously capture Voice of Customer (VoC) from catching programs and adjust prioritization and scope to maximize impact.

* Backlog leadership
+ Author and maintain Epics, Features, and User Stories with acceptance criteria; ensure traceability to business outcomes and regulatory/compliance needs.
+ Lead backlog grooming, PI planning, and cross‑program dependency management (SAFe or equivalent).

* Bridge product \& engineering
+ Act as the primary interface between global product managers and engineering leads, ensuring scope clarity, non‑functional requirements (performance, reliability, security), and delivery quality.
+ Drive design‑to‑value decisions across ingestion, streaming, API exposure, and data storage layers in future.

* Healthcare interoperability \& data standards
+ Define patterns for HL7 v2\.x, FHIR \- Mapping/translation
+ Guide implementation choices for integration engines (e.g., Mirth/NextGen Connect, Cloverleaf, Rhapsody) and schema governance.

* Secure \& compliant data movement (on‑prem → cloud)
+ Own product requirements for connectivity (AWS Direct Connect, Site‑to‑Site VPN, SD‑WAN, private links), data in motion (TLS 1\.2/1\.3, mTLS, certificate rotation), and data at rest (KMS/HSM encryption, key rotation).
+ Define AuthN/AuthZ strategies (OIDC/OAuth2, SAML, RBAC/ABAC, least privilege) and secrets management.
+ Ensure adherence to HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, ISO 27001, and regional privacy laws (e.g., GDPR).

* Streaming \& data platform architecture
+ Shape the streaming roadmap using Kafka (brokers, topics, partitions, consumer groups, schema registry, Avro/Protobuf), Kafka Connect, and CDC pipelines or any similar technology
+ Partner with architects on scalable ingestion, schema evolution, replay, dead‑letter handling, and observability (OpenTelemetry, metrics, tracing, logs).

* AWS platform delivery
+ Define requirements and guardrails for AWS services such as S3, MSK (or self‑managed Kafka), Glue, EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, PrivateLink, CloudWatch, KMS, Secrets Manager.
+ Drive reliability goals (SLOs/SLAs, RTO/RPO), disaster recovery patterns, and multi‑account/multi‑region design as needed.

* Cloud cost optimization (FinOps)
+ Lead cost‑to‑serve modeling and reduction initiatives: right‑sizing, instance families compression/partitioning, autoscaling, and data egress minimization.
+ Establish cost dashboards, budgets, and per‑feature cost accountability.

* Cybersecurity \& privacy
+ Stay current with cybersecurity best practices (zero‑trust, network segmentation, vulnerability management, threat modelling, security testing, SBOM where applicable).
+ Champion privacy‑by‑design, data minimization, de‑identification/pseudonymization where appropriate.


**What You’ll Bring (Required Qualifications)**
* Experience: 12–15\+ years in product management/ownership or platform leadership, with 5\+ years focused on data platforms/streaming and 3\+ years in healthcare data interoperability.
* Deep technical fluency in:
+ Streaming with Kafka (clusters, partitioning strategy, throughput/latency tuning, schema registry).
+ Data security: encryption at rest/in transit, AuthN/AuthZ (OIDC/OAuth2/SAML), RBAC/ABAC, secrets management.
+ AWS core data \& networking services; secure connectivity from on‑prem to cloud (Direct Connect, VPN, private connectivity).
+ Cybersecurity controls and compliance frameworks relevant to healthcare (HIPAA/HITRUST/SOC 2\).

* Healthcare standards: hands‑on with HL7 v2, FHIR
* Roadmap \& execution: proven track record translating vision into incremental deliveries; ownership of Epics/Features/Stories and measurable outcomes.
* Cross‑functional leadership: success aligning multiple global product managers and engineering teams in a highly dynamic environment.
* Cloud cost reduction: demonstrable wins lowering run‑rate and egress costs, optimizing storage/compute, and implementing FinOps practices.
* Communication: excellent written/verbal skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non‑technical stakeholders and vice‑versa.
* Hands on experience in Product Management using Gen AI tooling


**Nice To Have (Preferred Qualifications)**
* Experience with integration engines (e.g., Mirth/NextGen Connect, Cloverleaf, Rhapsody), and EMR/vendor ecosystems (Epic, Oracle Health/Cerner, Meditech, etc.).
* Knowledge of data governance \& cataloguing (e.g., AWS Lake Formation, Glue Data Catalog), lineage, DQ frameworks, and PHI/PII handling patterns.
* Familiarity with event‑driven and API‑first architectures (REST/gRPC), Idempotency, Exactly‑once/At‑least‑once semantics.
* Observability tooling (CloudWatch, Datadog, Splunk,Promethesu, Graffana) and SRE practices (error budgets, SLOs).


**Inclusion and Diversity**
 GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status, or other characteristics protected by law.
   

  

 We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive owners…

jobs.description:
We’re in an unbelievably exciting area of tech and are fundamentally reshaping the data storage industry. Here, you lead with innovative thinking, grow along with us, and join the smartest team in the industry.
   

  

 This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.
   

  

**THE ROLE**
 At Everpure, we’re redefining the data experience. We’re looking for a Business Systems Analyst to help operationalize and support our SKU management processes from within the Supply Chain organization. This role is critical in ensuring that SKU management activities are executed accurately and on time for our product lifecycle milestones such as new product introduction (NPI), sustaining commercial updates, and End\-of\-Sale (EOS).
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 As a Business Systems Analyst – SKU Lifecycle Management, your focus will be on execution, data accuracy, and operational support. You will be responsible for ensuring that new product configurations and updates are implemented cleanly in our CPQ tools in alignment with product launches, and deprecating products in alignment with Everpure’s End\-of\-Sales process.
   

  

* Support the execution and validation of SKU configurations in partnership with Product Management and other Supply Chain teams.
* Own the accuracy and completeness of the seller experience provided by our SKU configurations.
* As the owner of the seller's SKU experience, you will collaborate with Product Management teams to guide best practices for configuring new products.
* Update product attribute data and deprecate products in alignment with sustaining and end\-of\-sales lifecycle milestones.

In this role, you will be the analytical engine behind decisions that determine where inventory sits across our fulfillment network — directly impacting customer delivery speed, shipping costs, and inventory health at scale.
   

  

 You will partner closely with Program Managers, Operations, Supply Chain, and Tech teams to identify inefficiencies, surface insights from large and complex datasets, and translate them into actionable recommendations. The ideal candidate is someone who lives and breathes data, has strong SQL chops, can build dashboards that tell a story, and brings sharp business acumen to identify and solve hard, ambiguous problems. We are looking for a hands\-on operator — someone who does not wait for clean data or perfect requirements, but rolls up their sleeves, digs into the problem, and drives it to closure.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 ∙ Deep\-dive analytics: Independently scope, design, and execute complex analyses on inventory placement, network flow, regional demand patterns, fill rates, and outbound shipping cost drivers. Translate raw data into clear, actionable business insights.
   

  

 ∙ Dashboard and reporting ownership: Build, automate, and maintain self\-serve dashboards (QuickSight, Tableau, or similar) that give stakeholders real\-time visibility into key placement, inventory health, and network performance metrics.
   

  

 ∙ SQL and data engineering: Write efficient, production\-grade SQL on large datasets (Redshift, Hive, Athena). Build and maintain ETL pipelines, data marts, and reusable datasets that scale across the team.

 ∙ Stakeholder communication: Present findings to senior leadership in crisp, data\-backed narratives — both written documents and verbal reviews. Influence decisions without authority.
   

  

 ∙ Tooling and automation: Identify manual, repetitive workflows and automate them using SQL, Python, or scripting. Continuously raise the bar on team productivity.
